controller: ideal position/angle model pilot; no verified hardware firmware
checks: Cold start reaches hover through real shaft spin-up, power caps and rigid-body integration
Forward control moves the vehicle and release brakes into position hold
Yaw control turns right and releases into zero yaw rate
Lateral control follows the current heading
Climb and descent change held altitude without overriding gravity
ANGLE mode levels attitude on release without promising position hold
Landing reaches the floor gently and commands physical motor coast-down
Every supported blade count uses its own CAD mass and hover reference
Multiple rotor pairs preserve their changed CAD inertia and model limits
Controller never upgrades the documented MN1330 power case to obtain lift
Landing during cold spin-up cancels takeoff and coasts at the floor
Extended RPM is confined to free assumptions; real-data cases retain2400/min
Excess attitude ends the run instead of silently recovering the airframe
scope: Fixed120Hz model flight, no measured flight/servo/forward-flight validation
